comments.body:
Just tested and apparently you can pull R17 Appraisal quest with this skill. The thing is you probably need Artist's Growth 1 equipped as well (I equipped both so not checked that one yet) but good thing is you can pull both R17 Art and Appraisal together for convenience.

Of course if you prefer just doing the Appraisal one, Treasure Hunter's Growth 1 saves your college credits than this.
